invariants.description: the valve state stays in [0, 1] (Mynard 2012 Eq. 6-7: the rates vanish at 0 and 1), to the solver tolerance (1e-6)
the effective area follows the state (Mynard 2012 Eq. 4-5): A_eff = ((M_st - M_rg) zeta + M_rg) A_nn

the valve only opens under a forward pressure difference and only closes under a reverse one over output steps with one sign of the pressure difference (a step against it at most 1e-5, ten times the solver noise)
invariants.expr: np.all(np.diff(zeta)[((u_in - u_out)[:-1] < -1) & ((u_in - u_out)[1:] < -1)] <= 1e-5) & np.all(np.diff(zeta)[((u_in - u_out)[:-1] > 1) & ((u_in - u_out)[1:] > 1)] >= -1e-5)

invariants.applies: the reversal protocol at the run parameters (rates K_vo, K_vc of order 0.1 m^3/(J s))
